2_Introduction: The champion device showed a PCE of 25.0942%, with JSC of 26.482 mA/cm², FF of 81.8073%, and VOC of 1.1583 V. The mixed perovskite (Cs0.05MA0.1FA0.85PbI3.0) precursor solution was prepared with a total concentration of 1.65 mol/L in DMF/DMSO co-solvent. A two-tier spin-coating strategy (1000 rpm/5 s and 5500 rpm/30 s) produced a uniform and defect-minimized perovskite layer. During the second step, 150 µL of chlorobenzene was dropped on the spinning substrate 15 s before the end of the process. After the spin coating was completed, it was annealed on a hot stage at 110 °C for 15 min.
3_Result_Discussion: The triple A-site cation composition of Cs0.05MA0.1FA0.85PbI3.0 optimizes the tolerance factor to enhance phase stability and suppress ion migration tendencies, while the precursor concentration of 1.65 mol/L in a DMF/DMSO co-solvent system facilitates the formation of a PbI2·DMSO intermediate phase that retards crystallization for improved morphological control. The two-tier spin-coating protocol, initiating with a 1000 rpm spread step followed by a high-speed 5500 rpm crystallization stage, promotes uniform precursor distribution and subsequent dense packing, with the precisely timed introduction of 150 µL chlorobenzene antisolvent 15 seconds before the spin-coating conclusion inducing rapid supersaturation and homogeneous nucleation to yield a compact, pinhole-minimized film. Subsequent thermal annealing at 110 °C for 15 minutes then drives off residual solvents, completes the crystallization process to enlarge grain domains, and anneals out point defects, thereby reducing non-radiative recombination centers and improving charge carrier lifetimes, which collectively enhances charge extraction and minimizes voltage losses at the interfaces. This optimized crystallization dynamics and defect-suppressed morphology directly enabled the champion device to achieve a high open-circuit voltage of 1.1583 V, a short-circuit current density of 26.482 mA/cm², a fill factor of 81.8073%, and a power conversion efficiency of 25.0942%.
